description: Rank n+2 coefficient-level subtractions (all parent coefficients, old and new) from the series definition of tools/rank_n2/theory/subtraction_formulas.py at 40 digits, for random inputs in the argument layout of crates/ninjars/src/fast/subtractions_x2.rs. `expected[k]` is the amount subtracted from divnum[indices[k]] (slot label slots[k] = [t, x, mu2]).
